jobs.description:
Our client is a high-tech company and a spin-off of KU Leuven, operating as one of Europe's largest research centers and tackling a wide range of technological challenges. Innovation is at the heart of everything they do.

Would you like to be at the forefront of developments in artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and ICT? Then don't hesitate to apply. This could be your opportunity to contribute to the technologies of tomorrow and help shape the future.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, an internationally renowned research organization based in Leuven and recognized worldwide as a pioneer in nanoelectronics and digital technology, is looking for a Line Coordinator Helpdesk.

Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about keeping processes running smoothly? Then this Line Coordinator Helpdesk opportunity might be the perfect fit for you.

Your Role

As a Line Coordinator Helpdesk, you play a key role in reviewing and processing operational requests. You ensure that all submissions meet the required standards and guidelines while maintaining a high level of accuracy and quality.

Your responsibilities:
	
• Review and evaluate DUPLO signature requests.	
• Verify that operations and specifications comply with established procedures and guidelines.	
• Check submitted information for accuracy and completeness.	
• Approve and sign off validated operations in DUPLO.	
• Communicate with requesters when additional information, corrections, or clarification is needed.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys working accurately and taking responsibility.

What we're looking for:
	
• Bachelor's degree required.	
• No prior experience necessary; motivated starters are welcome.	
• Strong attention to detail and accuracy.	
• Analytical and logical mindset.	
• Good communication skills.	
• Ability to work independently and make sound decisions within defined guidelines.	
• Excellent knowledge of Dutch and English.

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

 
• You help produce precast concrete elements.
 
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
 
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
 
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
 
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.

 As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

 
• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
 
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
 
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
 
• You can work both independently and in a team.
 
• You work safely and in an orderly way.

Nice-to-haves

 
• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

As a CE Truck Driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely transportation of sand, rubble, and other bulk materials between various construction sites and designated locations.

Your profile

 
• You hold a valid CE driving licence and are in possession of a valid Code 95 certificate.
 
• Experience operating tipper trucks within the construction sector is considered a strong asset.
 
• You are confident driving a 6x6 and/or 4x4 vehicle.
 
• You communicate fluently in either Dutch or English.
 
• You work independently, responsibly, and with a strong focus on safety.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Mendix Low-Code Expert to join a major international IT project within a European institutional environment in Brussels.

You will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining secure, scalable and accessible business applications using Mendix. Working within an Agile and multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate with business analysts, UX/UI specialists, testers and project teams to transform business requirements into robust digital solutions.

The role also involves enterprise integrations, application security, reusable components, testing, deployment and production support.

Your Role:

As a Mendix Low-Code Expert, you will:

• Translate business requirements and user stories into robust Mendix applications.
• Design domain models, workflows, user interfaces and application security roles.
• Develop integrations with internal and external systems using REST APIs, database connectors and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
• Work with authentication technologies such as SAML and OIDC.
• Develop reusable Mendix modules, widgets and components.
• Contribute to shared development standards and best practices.
• Apply secure-by-design principles, role-based access control and data-protection requirements.
• Develop accessible interfaces in line with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
• Write unit and automated tests and participate in code reviews.
• Monitor application quality and contribute to the management of technical debt.
• Support deployments, release management and third-level production support.
• Produce and maintain technical documentation.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Mendix development practices. 
The Profile We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a highly experienced Mendix Developer / Low-Code Expert with a strong software-development background and proven experience delivering enterprise applications.

You should have:

• At least 5 years of IT development experience.
• At least 3 years of hands-on Mendix development experience.
• Mendix Advanced Developer certification or higher.
• Experience delivering at least two Mendix applications into production.
• Practical experience with Mendix 10 or later.
• Experience integrating Mendix applications with enterprise systems.
• Experience with on-premises and/or private-cloud environments.
• Working knowledge of Java and JavaScript, particularly for custom Mendix actions, widgets or extensions.
• Experience working in Scrum or another Agile development framework.
• Strong understanding of application security, testing, integration, maintainability and software-development best practices.
• English at C1 level.
Key Skills:

• Mendix 10+
• Low-Code Application Development
• Domain Modelling
• Microflows / Application Workflows
• REST APIs & Enterprise Integrations
• SAML / OIDC
• Role-Based Access Control
• Java
• JavaScript
• Application Security
• Testing & Quality Assurance
• Production Support
• Agile / Scrum
• Technical Documentation
• WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
Desired Qualifications:

The following would be considered strong advantages:

• Mendix Expert Developer certification.
• Experience working within a European institution, public administration or other large-scale public-sector environment.
• Experience with Mendix AI capabilities, including GenAI connectors or Maia.
• Experience leading or contributing to complex enterprise Mendix implementations.
• Experience developing reusable Mendix components and shared application libraries. 
Additional Information

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Working regime: Full-time
• Environment: International and multicultural
• Language: English C1 required; French is considered an advantage
• Work arrangement: Brussels-based; specific on-site/teleworking arrangements will be communicated during the recruitment process.
What We Offer:

Joining Alsena means contributing to high-impact international IT projects within a complex and multicultural environment.

You will have the opportunity to work on large-scale digital solutions, strengthen your expertise in Mendix, low-code development, enterprise integrations, application security and cloud environments, and contribute to modern applications used in a demanding institutional context.

You will work alongside experienced technical professionals while gaining exposure to complex enterprise systems and modern software-development practices.

Your next professional opportunity starts here ¿ apply now!

This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

You are the day-to-day point of contact on the production floor, making sure the team knows what needs to be done. You keep a close eye on both the employees and the production process.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

 
• 
You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, food safety and hygiene.

 
• 
You keep track of production planning and staffing levels and make adjustments when necessary.

 
• 
You identify operational bottlenecks and look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.

 
• 
You motivate employees, provide feedback and address issues when necessary.

 
• 
You contribute to strong teamwork and a positive working atmosphere.

 
• 
You support new colleagues during their onboarding and training.

 
• 
You work closely with other departments and report on daily operations.

 
• 
When the situation requires it, you are happy to roll up your sleeves and work alongside the team on the production floor.

You keep a cool head when plans change and understand what your team needs to keep moving forward. You are visible and approachable on the production floor, provide clear direction and make adjustments where necessary. Sound like you? Then this could be your dream job!

 
• 
You have experience in the food industry, preferably within a production or packaging environment.

 
• 
Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leading role is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You know how to motivate and coach employees and provide clear, constructive feedback.

 
• 
You communicate clearly, respectfully and assertively.

 
• 
When organising the work, you take both quality and efficiency into account.

 
• 
You are able to set priorities and organise daily activities effectively.

 
• 
You take responsibility and show initiative.

 
• 
Changing circumstances sometimes require quick adjustments, and you are able to respond accordingly.

 
• 
You enjoy being present on the production floor and are willing to work alongside the team when needed.

 
• 
You work daytime hours, but are flexible when necessary.

 
• 
You have a good language of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?
	
• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.	
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.	
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.	
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.	
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.	
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?
	
• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.	
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.	
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.	
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.	
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.	
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.	
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.

In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

jobs.description:

What will you do?

✅ Collect and prepare orders like a true professional

✅ Work with a high order‑picking truck (no fear of heights!)

Your work schedule:

Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full‑time or part‑time. For part‑time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

✔️ A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker

✔️ No fear of heights and good physical condition

Digitribe is looking for a Programme Management Officer (PMO) to join a large-scale cloud transformation programme at one of our clients, a major player in the financial services sector. You'll be the operational engine of the programme: you keep governance, planning, reporting, finances and risks under control, so the Programme Manager can focus on strategic decisions and sponsors.

The programme covers several streams: cloud migrations, technology foundations, cloud risk and resilience, non-technology foundations (people, process, FinOps), strategic cloud use cases and partner governance. You'll work closely with the Programme Manager, Project Managers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, Change Managers, Finance/FinOps and Risk & Compliance.
Your role

• Run programme governance: steering committees, governance calendar, decision-ready materials, follow-up of actions and escalations

• Own the integrated programme roadmap, including critical path, milestones, bottlenecks and cross-stream dependencies

• Own the programme RAID log and decision log, and make sure every mitigation has an owner and a target date

• Produce monthly and quarterly reporting for the executive committee, the CIO, steering committees and sponsors

• Consolidate budgets, forecasts and actuals, and flag funding gaps and resourcing risks

• Build and maintain the end-to-end business case: investments, TCO, run costs, benefits, savings, and scenario and sensitivity analysis

• Track benefits and value realisation: migration progress, cloud adoption, cost savings, risk reduction

• Perform delivery health checks and challenge status and evidence

• Coordinate evidence for internal audit and regulatory reviews, including DORA

• Track commitments and joint initiatives with strategic technology partners

• 8+ years in programme management, PMO or portfolio governance within a large, complex organisation

• Proven ownership of integrated planning, RAID processes, executive reporting and dependency management

• Strong financial management skills: budgets, forecasts, actuals, investment reporting

• Hands-on experience building business cases for large IT or cloud programmes, including TCO, benefits quantification and scenario analysis

• Experience in financial services or another regulated environment

• Cloud transformation experience is a strong plus, ideally on Azure, including FinOps and partner governance

• Experience with audit and regulatory evidence (DORA) and with PPM tooling or dashboards is a plus

• MSP, PMP, Prince2, MOP, P3O or SAFe certifications are a plus

• Fluent English; French and/or Dutch is a plus

jobs.occupation: Store Manager - Premium/luxury retail - FR/ENGL M/V/X
jobs.description:
As Store Manager, you hold full responsibility for results, team leadership, and brand representation. You lead by example and ensure every client interaction reflects the boutique's DNA of elegance, service, and performance.

This role operates in an international context and requires daily professional communication in both English and French. Fluency in both languages, spoken and written, is mandatory.

The boutique plays by four values:

🎾 Play as one team  You lead, coach, and develop your team to deliver a consistently high level of service. You create a strong team culture built on accountability, collaboration, and performance. 

🎾 Play with elegance  You embody the Lacoste brand in your appearance, communication, and way of working. From client experience to store presentation, attention to detail is second nature to you.

🎾 Play with audacity  You take ownership, identify opportunities, and proactively improve performance and processes. You are comfortable taking decisions and driving change where needed.

🎾 Play with tenacity You are results driven and KPI focused. You translate targets into concrete actions and follow through with discipline and consistency.
 
What they're looking for:

• Proven recent experience in a senior leadership role in retail within premium or luxury retail
• Fluent command of English and French, both spoken and written, is mandatory
• Flexibility to work weekends, evenings, and public holidays when required
• Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and retain high performing teams
• Strong commercial and analytical mindset with clear ownership of results
• Ability to operate at management level within an international retail organisation 
What they offer:

• Full-time undetermined contract after a 3 month contract 
• A key leadership role in one of the boutique's strategic Brussels locations
• A dynamic and premium working environment within an iconic brand
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Competitive salary with performance based bonus
• Generous employee discount on their collections
Are you the Store Manager they are looking for?

As a Patent Paralegal, you will provide administrative support for formal patent procedures in Belgium, Europe and abroad. Your responsibilities will include:

• Registering and following up on patent-related deadlines 

• Monitoring worldwide changes in procedural matters and implementing these changes in our procedures 

• Coordinating the filing of patent applications 

• Carrying out general administrative tasks  

About you
 

We are looking for someone who:
 
 

• Holds a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree 

• Has a strong judicial affinity 

• Has excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus

• Has excellent Microsoft Office skills

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

We are currently hiring an Operations Line Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:
You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.

• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.
